overall_summary: Analysis of the recent 16 videos shows that 'self respect' and boundary-setting topics (like muting chats, removing emergency contacts, hiding blue ticks) consistently attract higher views (averaging 30-40 views) compared to generic late-night or one-sided love themes (which range between 5-20 views). However, overall engagement (likes and comments) remains sparse across the board, indicating low sample size and early-stage channel dynamics.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on concrete boundary actions like muting pinned chats ('0H4VygZ3DIU', 21 views), removing emergency contacts ('hrjJ-QS9M8w', 12 views), hiding blue ticks ('wFimeeP_aVc', 35 views), and status list pruning ('rwOUYo_hayQ', 39 views) perform better than abstract emotional pain.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on micro-actions related to digital detachment and self-preservation.

winning_patterns.evidence: Hooks mentioning specific phone interfaces ('स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर उन्हीं का नाम था', 'ब्लू टिक्स आज छिपा दिए') outperform poetry-heavy openers.
winning_patterns.action: Use specific smartphone actions or interface states as immediate hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' ('uIbMpCjVutQ', 5 views) and 'रात के दो बजे' ('G0gKV1p3ZHc', 12 views) underperform.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid vague time-of-night tropes unless paired with a very specific, actionable digital behavior.
